scenes.name: Count
scenes.line: One big tap counts it. Reps, water, pages, cups of tea. Set a target, and watch the ring close.

scenes.name: Quit
scenes.line: Quitting something? Your days free count themselves. See the money you saved, and every time you said no.

scenes.name: Milestones
scenes.line: Ten badges, from day one, to day three hundred and sixty five. Every one you earn stays yours.

scenes.name: Themes
scenes.line: Four colours, light and dark, in six languages.

scenes.name: Privacy
scenes.line: No account. No ads. No internet. Your data never leaves your phone.

scenes.name: Outro
scenes.line: HabitTap. Counter, and quit habit. Free, offline, and private.
